description: PAID $0.001 USDC. Solana token holder concentration: top-10 share of supply, largest holder share, exchange-labelled holders and a low / medium / high verdict with reasons. Pass the mint as address. Returns JSON top-10 share, largest holder share, exchange-labelled share, and a low, medium, or high verdict.

address.description: Solana token mint. Format: a base58 Solana mint address. Example: DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain of the mint. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: solana. Allowed values: solana.

name: token_holders
title: Solana token holder concentration ($0.001)
